title: A Neural Latent Dynamics Approach for Solving Inverse Problems in Cardiac Electrophysiology
summary: Solving inverse problems in cardiac electrophysiology consists in the recovery of physiological parameters from surface electrocardiogram (ECG) measurements, a task which is often computationally unfeasible due to the severe ill-posedness and the prohibitive computational complexity of PDE-constrained optimization. In this work, we introduce a data-driven framework leveraging Latent Dynamics Networks (LDNets) to construct efficient surrogate models of the forward operator.
